title: Constraint Decay: The Fragility of LLM Agents in Back End Code Generation
summary: This research paper investigates 'constraint decay' - a critical failure mode where LLM agents progressively violate initial constraints during extended backend code generation tasks, becoming increasingly fragile and unreliable as context grows.
problem_solved: Identifies and measures how LLM agents lose track of specified constraints over time during multi-step code generation tasks.
why_valuable: Provides empirical evidence of a fundamental limitation in current LLM architectures for software engineering, enabling developers to build more robust AI-assisted coding tools.
